  "overall_experience": "The Assistant Professor likely found Bitwarden to be an indispensable tool for managing the vast number of credentials required in their role within a large educational institution. Its ability to securely store and autofill passwords across multiple systems significantly improved efficiency and security. While generally seamless, minor frustrations with autofill consistency and initial organizational setup were noted, but did not detract from an overwhelmingly positive experience."
